justification.dataset: Dandiset 000044 Achilles CA1 tetrode recordings on a 1.6 m linear track is the canonical dataset for hippocampal theta phase precession.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, correct maze epoch, excitatory-cell filtering, direction-specific run-bout detection, and a theta LFP channel with a verified 9.2 Hz peak are all handled correctly.
justification.analysis: Uses the Kempter circular-linear correlation with a phase-permutation null, direction-oriented field-progress coordinate, grid-search regression for sign/slope, an SI time-shift shuffle for place-cell selection, and a per-traversal control ruling out pooling artifacts.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (120 cell-directions, 80 neg / 5 pos, median r -0.32, median slope -0.52, 2075 traversals, 81% negative) reproduces exactly from precession_results.json and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, show the diagonal precession band in pooled and single-cell views, and example cells are ranked by correlation strength (the effect itself), not by slope.
justification.honesty: The write-up is proportionate and reports both directions of the effect including the 5 positive cases, but it states no explicit limitations (single session, theta-channel choice), which caps it at 3 for a genuinely clean result.
justification.verdict: A rigorous, reproducible, honest demonstration of phase precession that any PI would accept and move on from.
